big_case.notes: Emergency Purcell stay application by New Hampshire's Secretary of State and Attorney General granted by the full Court on October 22, 2026 (over a noted dissent by Justice Jackson with a detached opinion) less than two weeks before the November 3, 2026 federal general election. The order carries notable institutional weight on the reach of Purcell to executive election-administration guidance and post-injunction compliance efforts, tempered by its interim posture and narrow state-law scope (considering student IDs alongside other evidence under New Hampshire's statutory safety valves while leaving HB 323 facially intact).
